tolerance.belowFloorNote: Written under a lower floor and not refined since. The gate set is mixed-generation, so atFloor is not a clean measurement. NOTE that a reprocess does not necessarily clear this: a gate only refines from a recording in ITS OWN (course, context), so a pair with no usable capture keeps pre-raise geometry indefinitely. Deep Forest lobby is the worked example -- 27 samples, still at the old floor, and its only lobby recordings are 11-18 second fragments that learn nothing.
